# Afşin Belediyesi

> Official municipal government website providing services, announcements, and administrative information for Afşin residents.

Afşin Municipality (Afşin Belediyesi) is a Turkish local government authority serving the Afşin district. The website offers comprehensive municipal services including building permits, e-government services, event information, and official announcements.

## Key Topics

- Afşin Municipality
- Municipal Services
- Building Permits
- E-Government
- Public Announcements
- Koray Kıraç (Mayor)
- Municipal Council
- Construction Permits
- Building Numbering
- Tenders and Procurement
- Municipal News
- Local Administration
- Public Notices

## Core Services

- [Hizmetlerimiz](https://afsin.bel.tr/hizmetler): Municipal services including permits, taxes, and e-government
- [İmar İşleri](https://afsin.bel.tr/hizmet/imar-isleri): Building and construction permit services documentation
- [İnşaat Ruhsatı](https://afsin.bel.tr/hizmet/insaat-ruhsati): Construction permit application procedures and requirements
- [Yapı Kullanım](https://afsin.bel.tr/hizmet/yapi-kullanim): Building use permit and occupancy license services
- [Numarataj](https://afsin.bel.tr/hizmet/numarataj): Building numbering and address registration service

## News & Announcements

- [Güncel Duyurular](https://afsin.bel.tr/duyurular): Current announcements and news from Afşin Municipality
- [Güncel İlanlar](https://afsin.bel.tr/ilanlar): Current municipal listings and public announcements
- [Güncel İhaleler](https://afsin.bel.tr/ihaleler): Current tenders and procurement announcements

## Municipal Administration

- [Afşin Belediye Başkanlığı](https://www.afsin.bel.tr): Afşin Municipality official homepage with municipal services
- [Başkan Özgeçmiş](https://afsin.bel.tr/icerik/baskan-ozgecmis): Biography and background of Mayor Koray Kıraç
- [Meclis Üyeleri](https://afsin.bel.tr/profil-kategori/meclis-uyeleri): Municipal council members and assembly representatives

## Reports & Documentation

- [Faaliyet Raporları](https://afsin.bel.tr/faaliyet-raporlari): Activity reports and performance documentation from Afşin Municipality
- [Performans Programları](https://afsin.bel.tr/icerik/performans-programlari): Performance programs and strategic planning documents

## Community & Events

- [Etkinlikler](https://afsin.bel.tr/etkinlikler): Community events and activities organized by Afşin Municipality
- [İletişim](https://afsin.bel.tr/iletisim): Contact information and communication channels for Afşin Municipality

## Optional

- [Foto Galeri](https://afsin.bel.tr/foto-galeri): Photo gallery of municipal events and activities
- [Video Galeri](https://afsin.bel.tr/video-galeri): Video gallery of municipal news and announcements
